title: Celebration · voucher reveal
description: Offer-delivery email only. Place the voucher as high as possible.
usage: Offer-delivery hero. Confetti band, next-step strip, the voucher artefact and wallet buttons. The voucher artwork is never restyled. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: JPG, cover. Applied as a td background (background attr + CSS + VML v:fill for Outlook); bgcolor #FFEFAA fallback. Locked.
Transparent PNG, locked. Card is 423px wide centred in the slot, as in Figma.

notes: Celebration band text is the primitive color/charcoal/1000 (#222731) in Figma, so it stays charcoal in dark mode over the light confetti image — no dm class.

Wallet buttons sit side by side with a 16px spacer on desktop and stack with an 8px gap on mobile (spacer td also carries mfs-stack and collapses to an 8px row). Images centred on mobile with mfs-auto.
Fallback link is #001489 underlined with mfs-dm-link (purple in dark mode, matching the Figma Dark frame).
Voucher artwork contains magenta [XXXX] placeholders for member / NRC / expiration — these must be produced per recipient by the voucher system, not edited here.
Outlook desktop renders the confetti via VML; if background images are blocked the band falls back to pale yellow #FFEFAA.
Headline 38→28px and eyebrow 28→24px on mobile; padding 48→32px.
